description:
SURFACED by fz-yj0.4 AND fz-yj0.5 audits (both independently recommend it). CONCORDANCE / north-star: reduce duplicated code.

Because GroundValue is an 8-variant SUPERSET, each subsystem that consumes only a SUBSET must reject the impossible variants. The migrations do this with hand-copied 'GroundValue::<impossible> => unreachable!("...")' match arms:
- fz-yj0.4 (body literals, 6-variant subset {Int,Float,Atom,Bool,Nil,Binary}): 5 copies of 'EmptyList | Utf8Binary => unreachable!()' across literal_repr/lower_backend_literal/literal_ty/literal_map_key/literal_value.
- fz-yj0.5 (dispatch consts, 7-variant subset, no Binary): 7 copies of 'Binary => unreachable!()' with an IDENTICAL comment string across native/body/semantic/receive/dispatch_exec.
- fz-yj0.6 will add more for its subset.
That is O(N-subsystems) duplicated panic arms asserting the same invariant, each a latent panic if a future author matches the wrong-sourced value.

FIX (correct-by-construction): give GroundValue narrowing accessors that reject the impossible variants at ONE boundary, e.g. as_body_literal(&self) -> Option<BodyLiteral> (closed 6-variant view) and as_dispatch_shape(&self) -> Option<DispatchShape> (7-variant view). Each consumer then matches a CLOSED subset type -- no per-site unreachable, no copy-paste, no wrong-value panic risk. Reduces duplication from O(N) to O(1) and makes the subset invariants type-enforced.

NOTE: not fold-able into .4/.5/.6 themselves -- the 7 sites return different types (ValueId/Var/Ty/Option/bool) around their arms, so this is a second migration layer over the carrier fold. Sequence AFTER .6 so all subsets are known. Belongs to the fz-yj0 epic; end-of-epic concordance cleanup.

VERIFY: git grep 'unreachable!' near GroundValue matches -> 0 hand-copied superset-rejection arms; lib green; single-threaded fixture_matrix still exactly 19.

comments.text: DONE (folded to 8e6a71116). Two narrowing accessors on GroundValue — as_body_literal (closed 6-variant BodyLiteral<'a>, None for EmptyList/Utf8Binary) + as_dispatch_shape (closed 7-variant DispatchShape<'a>, None for Binary), reference-carrying (&str/&[u8]) so no new clones. 13 duplicated superset-rejection unreachable!() arms -> 0; the impossible-variant invariant now expressed ONCE per subset and exhaustiveness type-enforced (can't re-add an impossible arm). Adversarial audit: all 13 sites behavior-identical, accessor mappings correct, .expect() reachability matches old unreachable! sets, no clone/lifetime regressions. lib 1231/0/9, clippy clean, single-threaded fixture 19. Closes the yj0-epic concordance capstone (supersedes the per-site unreachable pattern from .4/.5).

title: Fold the duplicated GroundValue superset-rejection unreachable arms into narrowing accessors
